name: Odin
source:
The protector of the Holy Sanctuary Valhalla situated in the middle of the Floating Continent of Yggdrasil, and watches over humanity from above.

Leaving the protection of Yggdrasil to the 4 goddesses she created, she only descends onto Yggdrasil whenever there is an emergency or something is in urgent need of her attention. In many ways, she can be said to be the arbitrator who eradicates any and all problems with her overwhelming power.

She was originally a god with the body of an adult and had overwhelming divinity that is often said to be equal in power to Surtr. After the 『Ragnarok War』, and the creation of the Floating Continent of Yggdrasil as well as the creation of the 4 goddesses, she has exhausted her powers. It is because of the loss in power that she has now reverted to a more youthful form, and has lost some of her memories of yore.

She is a very rational and valorous god. If she deems something or someone to be evil, she will pass judgement onto them without mercy.

「Ahaha! Good, I shall allow it! It has been awhile since I have last seen a reckless fool like you. I am the Absolute God Odin! Bear witness to my power!」

Weapon names: Gungnir (spear); Huginn, Muninn, Geri, Freki (blades)

[From [url=http://www.ninetail.tk/tde10/] Ninetail[/url]]
